name: Offline Neural Text to Speech
description: A natural-sounding voice for your whole computer, running entirely on your device. A Provider app: put it in your Providers folder, assign it to Text → speech in Settings → AI models, and every app that speaks uses it — no account, no key, nothing leaves your device. Eight voices, built on KittenTTS Nano (Apache-2.0), whose weights arrive once as a hash-pinned 24 MB download. Much better than the robotic Offline Text to Speech, and noticeably slower to start — keep both and pick per task.

say.label: Say something out loud on this device
say.detail: The voice is synthesised here, offline — nothing is sent anywhere, and nothing is saved. The first time, the 24 MB voice has to download.

voice.label: …in a particular voice
voice.detail: One of the app's eight voice names.
